posts.zh:
dsh-drop-file-to-path 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Codex 式拖拽：把任意文件拖入 DSH Web 界面，文件存入 ~/.dsh-dropbox，路径以整块蓝色 chip 插入输入框。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3d5ba8aacd47185b7e67.html
posts.en:
dsh-drop-file-to-path is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Codex-style drag-drop: drag any file into the DSH web GUI, it lands in ~/.dsh-dropbox, and the path is inserted into the composer as a whole blue chip.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3d5ba8aacd47185b7e67.html
